outcome: Seroreactivity to Toxoplasma gondii (IgG and IgM antibodies)
cohort: 782 subjects (391 with a history of surgery and 391 age- and gender-matched controls).
finding: Having a history of surgery was not significantly associated with Toxoplasma gondii seropositivity overall, but a history of hysterectomy was found to be a significant risk factor for T. gondii infection.
